levels.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن أسماء

notes: Two taḥwīl-free routes each write جويرية and نافع in their own place, so the tail is null
«كلما عبد الله بن عمر» is read as «كلاهما عن عبد الله بن عمر» (the word is garbled in the text)

Second route: the saying is Ibn Umar's first-person account («قال خرجنا مع النبي») with no named speaker; the scene figure «بعض بني عبد الله» is not a link. First-person narrative with an implicit speaker: needs_ruling (rule 11)
